description: A sample of a small fire that can be looped seamlessly. It's probably best suited for media in which a campfire or a similar small/controlled blaze is burning. I usually ask for credit, but it feels wrong this time given that I made very few alterations to the excellent work Spandau and HECKFRICKER provided. This one is louder than the other version, obviously. Also, "Heckfricker" is a funny word lol. Thanks to the following people whose quality audio made this project possible: - “campire.wav” by Spandau https://freesound.org/people/Spandau/sounds/40699/ - “Campfire 02” by HECKFRICKER https://freesound.org/people/HECKFRICKER/sounds/729396/
name: Hearthfire (Louder)
